name: PVV Infra Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, PVV Infra Limited is a MSME and is into infrastructure business.
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
a) Construction of Multi-storied commercial and residential buildings
b) Landscaping
c) Duplex housing
d) Housing for EWS, low, middle and high income groups

pros: Stock is trading at 0.94 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 7.47% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.34 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 281 days.
Working capital days have increased from 189 days to 322 days
